findings.summary: Changing the type assertion from obj.(Mock) to obj.(*Mock) makes AssertExpectationsForObjects panic on the deprecated by-value Mock call, because the following obj.(assertExpectationser) assertion runs on a plain Mock that lacks the pointer-receiver method, and the deprecation warning now fires for the wrong (*Mock) case.
Changing mutex from a lazily created *sync.Mutex to a value sync.Mutex means copying a Mock by value copies lock state, which go vet's copylocks flags.
